subject: Urgent: Kanalys throughput-drop / 500 spike — exec council & customer update
messages:
From: Priya Sood <priya.sood@kanalys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Townsend <ben.townsend@kanalys.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: sudden throughput drop + 500s (live since 08:55 PDT)

Marcus —

We started seeing a sharp drop in completed requests at ~08:55 PDT this morning across three production clusters. Throughput is down ~65% and we’re observing a spike in 500s originating from the Redwood inference endpoint (token generation). Latency has climbed from median 120ms to >800ms for many requests.

Attached is a telemetry snapshot and a short error log from one of our hosts (kanalys-telemetry-snapshot.json, kanalys-error-sample.log). Basic repro: POST /v1/generate for user ctx=retail-flow, seq=1024 — 75% chance of 500 after ~10 tokens.

We are on full customer watch — revenue traffic affected. Can Redwood confirm whether this is a routing/capacity issue or a model-side regression? We need an exec-level update in 30–45 minutes.

— Priya
Principal SRE, Kanalys
(attachment: kanalys-telemetry-snapshot.json - 28 KB)
(attachment: kanalys-error-sample.log - 4 KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sood <priya.sood@kanalys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:22:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: sudden throughput drop + 500s (live since 08:55 PDT)

Priya — thank you for the data. We’ve opened an internal priority thread and started gathering traces. Initial notes:
- Front-door (edge) shows normal acceptance rates until 08:54, then a downstream backlog forming to inference pool.
- Error traces show "KVCacheInvalidation" and a higher RTT to the pinned model instances.

Marissa / David — assigning to you to get a quick root-cause surface: please confirm if this is a serving runtime regression, autoscaler mis-signal, or a routing misroute (warm vs cold machines). Marcus (me) will coordinate customer comms and exec bridge.

Action: Please stand by for an exec council call at 09:35 PDT. I’ll loop in Hannah and Jonas for capacity & routing fallback plans.

— Marcus
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:27:40 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Kanalys outage triage — immediate steps

Team — quick triage log (live diagnostics):
1) Autoscaler: telemetry shows a delayed scale-up event between 08:56–09:04; pool drained due to health-check churn. Possible GC/OOM flapping on a subset of instances.
2) Model runtime: recent kernel change flagged in canary yesterday (PR #4921) touched attention-kernels; will validate rolling-back to prior build.
3) Routing: some requests routed to an older quantized variant with known higher error rates at >seq 768 — routing policy fallback may have mis-evaluated model compatibility.

Immediate mitigation plan (t0–t30):
- Revert last kernel patch on affected nodes (David)
- Force-scale a warm burst pool for Kanalys dedicated capacity (Jonas)
- Apply a temporary routing rule to ban the quantized variant for Kanalys traffic (Hannah)

I’ll push a mutual-action-plan doc to the shared drive and attach it to the customer note.

(attachment: redwood-m-a-plan-v1.xlsx)

— Marissa
Director, Production Reliability
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sood <priya.sood@kanalys.com>
Cc: Ben Townsend <ben.townsend@kanalys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:32:05 -0700
Subject: RE: Production: sudden throughput drop + 500s (live since 08:55 PDT) — exec council invite + immediate mitigations

Priya / Ben —

Thanks for the quick signal. We’ve stood up an exec council to coordinate remediation and customer communications. Join us for a 09:35 PDT bridge: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: RW-urgent). Agenda: 1) short RCA summary, 2) immediate mitigations, 3) rollback schedule + fallbacks, 4) customer recovery timeline.

Summary of current actions we’re executing (live):
- Forcing warm-burst capacity (+40% for Kanalys dedicated pools) — Jonas executing now.
- Rolling back attention-kernel change on suspect nodes — David on it.
- Temporary routing block on quantized variant for Kanalys — Hannah executing.
- Applying prefix/KV cache purge for the impacted user groups to avoid stale state — Marissa executing.

Customer ask: we’ll target a recovery signal (throughput within 90% of baseline, error rate <0.5%) within 30–45 minutes. I will provide rolling updates on the bridge and via this thread.

— Marcus
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:04:12 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: rollback completed + early recovery signal

All — quick technical update from the field: rollback of the attention-kernel patch completed at 09:58 PDT on the affected shard set. Observed behaviours:
- Error rate trending down from peak 12.4% -> 1.6% within 6 minutes of rollback.
- Throughput rebounding; currently at ~82% of normal for Kanalys cluster A, cluster B still warming.
- No persistent OOMs on restarted nodes; GC tuning applied to 3 nodes.

Next steps: keep a warm-burst active for +30 mins; monitor tail-latency. Hannah, please confirm routing block is holding and no traffic is being sent to the quantized variant. Marcus — recommend we go to customer with a measured status update: what we rolled back, ETA for full recovery, and interim mitigations.

— David
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sood <priya.sood@kanalys.com>, Ben Townsend <ben.townsend@kanalys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Kundensituation update — Kanalys throughput + errors (10:45 PDT)

Priya / Ben —

Update at 10:45 PDT: thank you for your patience. What we did:
- Identified culprit: recent attention-kernel change (deployed to a subset of inference nodes).
- Action taken: reverted kernel on affected nodes, applied GC tuning, and temporarily disabled routing to the quantized model variant for Kanalys traffic.

Observed impact (current):
- Error rate reduced from peak 12.4% down to 0.9% over the last 30 minutes.
- Aggregate throughput is at ~93% of baseline as nodes warm and traffic shifts to warm-burst capacity.
- Median latency trending back to 170ms; 95th at ~560ms and improving.

Next steps and commitments:
- Maintain warm-burst for 60 minutes and monitor tail metrics (we’ll share live telemetry link).
- Post-mortem and patch validation plan: we will run a canary suite against the kernel change and hold the patch until we validate stability across seq lengths. Expect an RCA within 48 hours and a detailed mitigation timeline.

We’ll continue to keep you updated every 30 minutes until fully recovered. If you want a readout to your execs, we can schedule a postmortem briefing this week.

— Marcus
Head of Customer Operations
(related ticket: HS-45321)
